2026-09-12: new card, authored directly in the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/53, {3}{U} Artifact). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed): '{T}, Exile this artifact: Add {U}. When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.' 5 SOURCE + 0 SINK facts, all annotated (card added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS, baked via compute-annotations.mjs; weights via compute-weights.mjs --slug=ether).

Baseline: self-cast ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Artifact'), self-enters ({event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', subject:'self', target:'self'}, same anchor).

Mana ability, modeled as 3 facts by direct analogy to phoenix-down's/elixir's own identical '{T}, Exile this artifact: ...' activation-cost shape (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's 2026-09-12 Phoenix Down entry is the house-style precedent mirrored exactly): self-tap-cost ({event:'tap', subject:'self', target:'self'}) and self-exile-cost ({event:'exile', subject:'self', target:'self'}), both bare cost-payment ACT tags with no zoneFrom/zoneTo (same shape isSelfTapActivationCostFact/isSelfExileActivationCostFact already exempt for phoenix-down — both exemptions are general, not per-card, so they cover Ether for free, no new verify-synergy.mjs change needed), plus the real effect itself: addMana ({event:'addMana', controller:'you', colors:{has:['U']}}), same colors-vocabulary shape cargo-ship's own '{T}: Add {C}' fact already uses. Neither cost fact can ever have real trace evidence: engine.ts's unsupportedCostComponent doesn't recognize '{T}, Exile this artifact' as a payable cost component at all (not pure mana/{T}, not the one accepted 'Sacrifice another/a/two X' pattern), so this card's activated ability can never be piloted through canActivateAbility/activateAbility — confirmed genuinely unpilotable, same as phoenix-down/elixir, hence this card's scenarios.ts stays plain harness.ts Scenario style (its own effects run directly, cost ignored) rather than engine-trace.ts. The addMana effect itself DOES get real trace evidence this way (trace.json's own real fn:'addMana' line), verified via a real run-scenarios.mjs run.

Real, documented gap, NOT modeled at all (no Fact, no Effect, no triggers entry invented): the delayed-trigger spell-copy half, 'When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.' Checked the actual engine surface rather than assuming: (1) no event-keyed delayed trigger exists anywhere in this codebase — interfaces.ts's only delayed-trigger primitive is delayUntil(phase, run) (real 603.4/603.7, phase-keyed, e.g. Elrond Moon-Reader's 'at the beginning of the next end step'), not an event-keyed 'next time X happens' observer; (2) no spell-copy Effect kind exists in card.ts's Effect union at all — copyPermanent (interfaces.ts, CardFactory.copyCard) only copies a PERMANENT already on the battlefield (Clone-style), and there's no stack-object model to duplicate an object off of in the first place. Grepped the whole pool for a prior spell-copy card: none exists — this is a genuinely new gap, not a rediscovered solved one. Both primitives would be needed together; building either alone wouldn't make this ability real.

verify-synergy.mjs scoped (ether): 0 hard failures. Full pool (317 checked): 4 pre-existing hard failures, ALL unrelated to this card (cecil-dark-knight-cecil-redeemed-paladin, ice-flan, stiltzkin-moogle-merchant, white-auracite — other concurrent sessions' own in-flight work per git status, not touched here). npx vitest run functional-model: 238/238 passed (unchanged baseline). find-synergies.mjs: Ether is a brand-new card (no prior HEAD version to diff against) — 37 real interaction lines total, all via the self-enters baseline fact ('enters the battlefield' matches against every other real ETB-presence-wanting sink in the pool, e.g. Summon: Bahamut, Elixir, Ambrosia Whiteheart, Restoration Magic, Ultima). Zero matches yet for event:'addMana'/'tap'/'exile' (expected — no sink in the pool currently wants any of those generically; same 'new, forward-looking vocabulary, 0 matches today' pattern the pump/exile promotions already established).
knownGaps: The delayed-trigger spell-copy half ('When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.') is completely unmodeled: no event-keyed ('next time X happens') delayed-trigger primitive exists in this engine (delayUntil is phase-keyed only), and no spell-copy Effect kind exists in card.ts's Effect union (copyPermanent only copies a battlefield permanent, Clone-style; there's no stack-object model to duplicate). Both are real, general engine gaps, not specific to this card — a future spell-copy card (Reverberate-style) would hit the identical wall.

Neither self-tap-cost nor self-exile-cost SOURCE fact can ever have real trace evidence: engine.ts's unsupportedCostComponent doesn't recognize this card's own '{T}, Exile this artifact' cost as payable, so canActivateAbility/activateAbility can never pilot this card's ability at all (a general, pre-existing engine limitation, not new to this card) — both facts rely on the existing general verify-synergy.mjs exemptions (isSelfTapActivationCostFact / isSelfExileActivationCostFact).
